facts.claim: Claude Sheets is a spreadsheet inside Claude, launched in beta on 10 November 2026.
facts.verbatim_support: Today we’re launching Claude Whiteboards and Claude Sheets in beta

facts.claim: Ask for a tracker, budget or model and Claude builds a working sheet.
facts.verbatim_support: Ask for a tracker, budget, or model, and Claude builds a working sheet

facts.claim: Claude can generate spreadsheets with tabs, formulas, formatting and drop-downs, e.g. a campaign tracker or hiring budget.
facts.verbatim_support: Claude can now generate spreadsheets with tabs, formulas, formatting, and drop-downs, often from just a prompt like asking for a campaign tracker or a hiring budget.

facts.claim: When Claude changes a sheet, each edit is outlined as it lands.
facts.verbatim_support: When Claude changes a sheet, each edit is outlined as it lands, so you can see what changed.

facts.claim: When other people are in the sheet, everyone works in the same cells at the same time.
facts.verbatim_support: When other people are in the sheet, you all work in the same cells at the same time.

facts.claim: For full Excel functionality, export to .xlsx or CSV or use Claude for Excel.
facts.verbatim_support: you can export your file to .xlsx or CSV, or use

facts.claim: Claude Sheets is in beta on Pro, Max, Ultra, Team and Enterprise plans.
facts.verbatim_support: Claude Sheets is available in beta on Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, and Enterprise plans.
